exposure: Gestational age at birth (<37 weeks, 37-38, 38-39, 39-40, >40 weeks)
outcome: Sonographic acetabular hip angles (alpha and beta angles)
Hip type according to Graf's classification
cohort: 342 newborns examined during their first week of life in a single, tertiary hospital
finding: In this cohort of term infants, gestational age at birth was not significantly associated with acetabular hip angles, while female sex and maternal thyroidopathy were identified as potential risk factors for developmental dysplasia of the hip.
birth_weight: Recorded but specific values not provided in the abstract
